The Founder

Senior expertise, made accessible.

Ingrid Lozana brings more than 15 years of experience in international logistics, supply chain, and business operations across the US and Latin America.

She founded IANEX to give growing companies direct access to the kind of strategic guidance usually reserved for large corporations. Practical, senior-level expertise focused entirely on helping clients grow and enter new markets with confidence.

Her approach pairs deep operational knowledge with a clear commercial perspective. Understand the business, simplify the complexity, and build the partnerships and processes that drive sustainable growth.

Home / Privacy Policy

PrivacyPolicy.

Last updated: 23 June 2026 · Template for client review. Independent legal review recommended.

Overview

This Privacy Policy explains how IANEX Global Services ("we", "us", "our") collects, uses, and protects personal information you provide through this website, primarily via our contact form. We are committed to handling your information responsibly and in line with applicable data protection requirements.

Information we collect

When you submit our contact form, we collect the information you choose to provide, which may include:

  • Your full name
  • Your email address
  • Your company name
  • The contents of your message or enquiry

We do not collect payment information through this website, and we do not sell your personal information.

How we use your information

  • To respond to your enquiry and communicate with you about your request
  • To arrange and follow up on a Discovery Consultation, if requested
  • To maintain a record of correspondence for legitimate business purposes

Booking & third-party services

Consultation bookings are handled through Calendly. When you schedule a consultation, your booking information is processed by Calendly in accordance with its own privacy policy. This website is hosted on Wix, which may process limited technical data such as cookies and basic analytics to operate and secure the site.

Data retention

We retain enquiry information only for as long as necessary to respond to your request and for reasonable business record-keeping, after which it is deleted or anonymised.

Your rights

Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of the personal information we hold about you, and to withdraw consent. To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details below.

Contact

For any questions about this Privacy Policy or your information, contact us at hello@ianexglobal.com.

This policy is provided as a template covering data collected via the contact form. The client is advised to obtain independent legal review to ensure full compliance with all applicable regulations.
